Name: Shaphan, Son of Azaliah
Summary: Shaphan, son of Azaliah and scribe, was sent by Josiah with Maaseiah and Joah to repair the house of the LORD; he carried the found book of the law to the king, reported the work, and read the book before Josiah, who rent his clothes.
KeyStory: Hilkiah gave Shaphan the book of the law, and Shaphan read it before the king, whose heart was tender and humbled.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Hilkiah, the High Priest; Ahikam, Son of Shaphan
LifeLesson: A scribe who carries God's book faithfully can start a nation's reformation.
